newsitem.title: USA: USDA reports soybean, soymeal sales to China.
newsitem.headline: USDA reports soybean, soymeal sales to China.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Thursday said net soybean sales to China in the week ended December 12 totalled 58,300 tonnes and soymeal sales were 50,000 tonnes.
In its weekly export sales report, the department said soyoil sales to China in December 12 week were 18,500 tonnes, including 18,000 tonnes switched from unknown destinations.
USDA said the soybean activity in the week included 3,700 tonnes in new sales, 55,000 tonnes in destination changes and 500 tonnes in foreign purchases/cancellations.
